-- Clear candidate2 for all house races where both candidates are the same person (uncontested)
UPDATE house_races 
SET candidate2_name = NULL, candidate2_party = NULL, candidate2_vote_pct = NULL, candidate2_votes = NULL
WHERE candidate1_name = candidate2_name AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL;

-- Same fix for senate races
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate2_name = NULL, candidate2_party = NULL, candidate2_vote_pct = NULL, candidate2_votes = NULL
WHERE candidate1_name = candidate2_name AND candidate1_name IS NOT NULL AND candidate2_name IS NOT NULL;
